name: Guobang Pharma Ltd.
summary: Guobang Pharma Ltd., a Chinese company, specializes in the research, development, manufacturing, and distribution of pharmaceutical products for both human and veterinary use within China. For human healthcare, their offerings encompass active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs), intermediate compounds related to these APIs, and finished dosage forms. In the animal health sector, they provide veterinary APIs, various additives, and prepared formulations. The company was founded in 1996 and has its headquarters situated in Xinchang, China.
